speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the specific location of your lower back pain and how far down your leg it travels. Also, rate your pain from 1 to 10.

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L5 or S1 nerve root compression).

The history of sudden onset pain in a 26-year-old while exercising, radiating from the lower back down the leg to the foot, is highly suggestive of a slipped disc. Have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your leg or foot?
